metadata.title: MPAS quasi-uniform x1.642 (N=642 cells, ~480 km)
metadata.description: MPAS Voronoi mesh with 642 cells, 1920 edges, max_edges=6. Quasi-uniform global sphere; 12 pentagons + 630 hexagons. Constructed algorithmically as the Voronoi dual of DUO icosahedral subdivision level 3 (10*4^3+2=642 vertices).
